services.name: Camera_RebuildDerivedCoordinateState
services.behavior: Combines the low camera-tile nibbles with PLAYER_X/PLAYER_Y to publish PLAYER_CAMERA_PIXEL_X/Y, then aligns WORLD_CAMERA_X/Y down to the 16-pixel camera tiles.

services.name: Camera_InitializeCoordinateState
services.behavior: Copies PLAYER_CAMERA_PIXEL_X/Y and CAMERA_TILE_X/Y into local and world player/camera state, clears CAMERA_SCROLL_X/Y, and initializes CAMERA_REFERENCE_X/Y to the aligned camera tiles.

relationship: The two entries are complementary coordinate transforms: the level/reset path initializes state from camera pixels and tiles, while the derived-state helper reconstructs camera-pixel and aligned-tile fields from local player and world-camera coordinates.
